statement: The independent rnconrad emulator contains Nunchuk and Classic 16-byte calibration templates duplicated into offsets 0x20 and 0x30, but that does not establish correct retail calibration field meanings, integrity checksum algorithm, acceptance/fallback rules or per-device defaults. Model-specific reference register reads plus independent checksum verification would resolve those questions without publishing anyone's raw calibration bytes.

applicability.revision: Official Nunchuk and Classic extension revisions not measured
applicability.scope: Physical extension EEPROM/register calibration validation; source review confirms emulator behavior only.
